product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates subscription and usage-based billing, payments, revenue recognition and revenue reporting for SaaS, AI, cloud and other recurring-revenue businesses.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing-plan page was found; the site directs prospective buyers to request a demo or contact sales, rather than publishing its own plans.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 61 employees as of 2026.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains business, billing, finance and product-oriented content; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed application links are Customer Support Lead, Monetization Engineer and Salesforce CRM Engineer; none meets the requested AI/ML/data-science title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Explicitly documented as a customer-enabled MCP integration with Claude; this does not establish the underlying model provider for Ordway’s native AI contract-capture or payments features.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is an independently audited attestation. GDPR is a publicly named compliance regime, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 5, 2026; the $20 million combines equity and debt, with no split disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No SDR, BDR or Account Executive appears among the explicitly listed current application links.

launched_6mo.notes: Ordway announced its AI-powered payments solution on July 22, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mike Miele’s profile dates his VP of Sales role at Ordway from March 2026, inside November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are documented CRM integration signals, not proof that Ordway uses both internally for its own sales operations.
